_comment: Trigger eval cases. Each runs in a fresh non-interactive session against
tools/eval/fixture/, and records which skill (if any) the agent invokes first.
'expect' is the skill slug, or null for utterances that should fire nothing.
'why' states what the case is actually testing, so a failure is interpretable.
A case only measures what the fixture can support. An utterance about
TypeScript errors in a repo with no TypeScript is a nonsense request and the
agent will explore instead of acting — that reads as a false negative. Keep
the fixture able to satisfy every named case.

cases.utterance: ts errors
cases.why: shortest form of the primary trigger, post-pruning

cases.utterance: fix types
cases.why: second surviving phrasing after five synonyms were collapsed to one branch

cases.utterance: this still isn't working after my change
cases.why: symptom trigger with no named keyword — the branch pruning kept deliberately

cases.utterance: review this
cases.why: competes with review-pr; parallel-review should win for a local diff

cases.utterance: review PR 41
cases.why: the other side of that collision — a PR reference should route away from local review

cases.utterance: commit this
cases.why: description cut from ~65 words to ~20; does the surviving trigger still fire

cases.utterance: grill me on this plan
cases.why: KNOWN COLLISION: the installed `grilling` skill claims the same word

cases.utterance: audit this ticket
cases.why: five triggers collapsed to two; explicit form

cases.utterance: is issue 12 still needed?
cases.why: the implicit form — a user who does not know the skill exists

cases.utterance: I need a helper to format a date for display
cases.why: THE HARD ONE: must fire autonomously. Nobody types 'reuse-first'. Also tests whether the CLAUDE.md pointer or the skill's own description does the work

cases.utterance: loadUsers is slow, can you look at it
cases.why: autonomous firing on a symptom; the fixture has a sequential-await loop

cases.utterance: there's a bug here and my last two fixes didn't work
cases.why: the 'previous fix didn't work' branch, which the rework kept as genuinely distinct

cases.utterance: we're mid-rebase and there are conflict markers everywhere
cases.why: description rewritten to fire on observable surface forms rather than the concept

cases.utterance: give me some logo concepts for a fintech brand
cases.why: one mode's trigger after four-way per-mode duplication was cut

cases.utterance: what does src/user.ts do?
cases.why: NEGATIVE: a plain question. Any skill firing here is over-triggering

cases.utterance: explain how TypeScript generics work
cases.why: NEGATIVE: near-miss on fix-ts-errors vocabulary without being a request to fix anything

cases.utterance: add a comment to the top of user.ts
cases.why: NEGATIVE: a trivial edit. `done` claims to fire after every task — this checks it does not pre-empt the work

cases.utterance: Name my desktop video downloader and find three memorable standard-price .com domains for it.
cases.why: primary branch: product naming and exact-domain discovery belong to the new skill

cases.utterance: Mix and match the useful words in VidsJar, ClipHarbor and StashBay, then check the new .com combinations.
cases.why: remix branch: a bare mix-and-match utterance carrying its own seeds should route here, with no skill named in the request

cases.utterance: Check which of Loamly, Pagebound and Readnest have normal-price .com domains and recommend the strongest one.
cases.why: verification branch: an inline shortlist still needs registry filtering, registrar evidence, and a naming recommendation

cases.utterance: Explain how domain name registration works.
cases.why: NEGATIVE: general domain education does not require product naming or availability discovery

cases.utterance: Register vidsjar.com for me.
cases.why: NEGATIVE: domain registration is an external mutation outside the read-only discovery skill

cases.utterance: I have an idea for a local-first reading app and need help naming it.
cases.why: greenfield branch: a product-naming request should enter the guided discovery funnel even before the user mentions domains

cases.utterance: I like the name VidsJar but want sharper variations that still have a usable .com.
cases.why: refinement branch: a user-created seed should enter the atom-remix route without restarting greenfield discovery

cases.utterance: I'm starting a new inventory app and need to plan its requirements and technical architecture before we write code.
cases.why: collision: a bare new-app utterance asking for requirements and architecture stays with project-discovery rather than routing to naming
